{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = data.duplicated().sum()

# Check for missing values
missing_values = data.isnull().sum()

# Check the unique sites
total_sites = data['site'].nunique()
unique_sites = data['site'].unique()

# Check the response column
response_counts = data['responded'].value_counts()

# Print findings
duplicates, missing_values, total_sites, unique_sites, response_counts"}
